intro: The first leg of route 1, from the home's front door to Hase Station's platform, laid out from your KM1-1 picture with the Kamakura models you approved. This is the layout before any level code is written: approve it, or tell me what to move, and the level is built from it (its scenes, play and hazards in the game's level builder).
About 105 m of lane, a 90-second leg at the kid's pace. The picture's ensemble is about 30 m wide, so its set pieces are spread along the lane in the picture's order, with the play between them.
reference: KM1-1 Hase Lanes, the photographic version the models were built from (the home, the vending corner, the shrine up its steps, the crossing, the platform).
strip: Each model at its real size and place, seen as the player will see it: the camera 12 m back, the lane (the green walking strip) at the front. See-through boxes are what is still to come. The shading is Blender's, not the game's toon look: judge the places, sizes, order and gaps.
decided: The delivery scooter is parked at the beige house's door while its rider delivers: an obstacle to dribble round. A scooter riding past would need its wheels modelled apart from the fork and exhaust its pictures draw over them.
The first-graders walk in a line ahead of the kid, slower, on the walking strip: get past without the ball touching one.
The tram crosses the lane toward the camera at the level crossing, as the game's crossings run their traffic: the bells ring, the barriers come down, wait for it to pass.
The block wall with the cat comes after the vending corner (in the picture it is left of the home, before the level's start).

The tram's tracks cross the street's depth, so in the level they get their own list that the house rows and the verge keep out of (LEARNINGS E11), and nothing taller than 0.4 m stands between the camera and the lane (E10).
ask: The lane's houses. The kit has two houses for KM1-1 (the home and the beige house); between the set pieces the lane needs more frontage. Would you like new lane-house sheets (two or three ordinary Kamakura houses, KM-B), or should I reuse the two houses repainted?

Three sheets the level waits on: KM-F02 (the persimmon's leaves), KM-F04 (the hydrangeas and morning glories) and KM-T07 (the lane and its walking strip). Their prompts are in docs/KAMAKURA_BUILD.md and on the prompts page.
Anything to move: a model's place, the order, the length, or the play beats.
